text.en:
The articles specifically listed in Annex "A" hereof, as classified
under Section 104 of the Tariff and Customs Code of 1978, as amended, shall be
subject to the rates of import duty in accordance with the schedule indicated
opposite each article.

The nomenclature and rates of import duty on tariff headings
not enumerated and those listed but represented by the symbol "x × x" shall remain
in force and in effect.

Upon the effectivity of this Executive Order, the articles
specifically listed in the aforesaid "Annex" which are entered and withdrawn from
warehouses in the Philippines for consumption shall be levied the rates of duty
herein prescribed.

All Presidential issuances, administrative rules and regulations,
or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby revoked
or modified accordingly.
PGMA Hologram # 23690

2/

This Executive Order shall take effect following its complete
publication in two (2) newspapers of general circulation in the Philippines.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30 day of Desembers
Lord, Two Thousand and Three.
, in the year of Our
By the President:
